target: forge.sh pr-create (gitlab) — FORGE_URL is the API base when set, and nothing is sent to the remote's host instead
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001 FORGE_URL=https://gl.example.test:9443
fx_http "GET /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests?source_branch=feat&state=opened" 200 '[]'
fx_http "POST /api/v4/projects/grp%2Fproj/merge_requests" 201 '{"iid":2,"web_url":"https://gl.example.test:9443/grp/proj/-/merge_requests/2"}'
fx_run pr-create --head feat --base main --title T --body-file body.md; fx_show r
echo "foreign_requests=$(fx_reqs | grep -c 'https://gitlab.example.test')"
fx_reqs
fx_done
